terms.definition: Describes diverse conditions on prerequisites FARE PRODUCTs and rights to buy other products

terms.label: AR Entitlement Parameters MODEL::ENTITLEMENT REQUIRED
terms.definition: A parameter indicating whether a particular FARE PRODUCT requires an entitlement to by or use an access right. Notes: Identifier of ENTITLEMENT REQUIRED.

terms.label: AR Luggage Usage Parameters MODEL::LUGGAGE ALLOWANCE
terms.definition: The number and characteristics (weight, volume) of luggage that a holder of an access right is entitled to carry. Notes: Identifier of LUGGAGE ALLOWANCE. Notes: Maximum bag depth. terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL
terms.definition: Describes conditions on when and how products can be booked or purchased.

terms.definition: Parameters indicating whether the access right requires reservation. terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::PURCHASE WINDOW
terms.definition: Period in which the FARE PRODUCT must be purchased. Notes: Identifier of PURCHASE WINDOW. Notes: Maximum duration before departure that ticket may be purchased. Notes: Minimum duration before departure that ticket may be purchased. Notes: Time point on the last day before departure that ticket may be purchased.

terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::BOOKING POLICY
terms.definition: A parameter giving common conditions for booking or cancelling an access right. Notes: Identifier of BOOKING POLICY..

terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::CANCELLING
terms.definition: A parameter giving conditions for cancelling of a booked access right. Notes: Whether or not the a booking may be cancelled. Notes: Whether or not the a booking may be cancelled. Notes: Identifier of CANCELING.

terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::RESERVATION MOMENT
terms.definition: A classification of moment at which a booking or reservation may be made, e.g. in advance, at stop, on boarding, on board, etc. Notes: Identifier of RESERVATION MOMENT.

terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::TYPE OF RESERVATION FEE

terms.label: AR Booking Usage Parameters MODEL::TYPE OF RESERVATION RULE

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL
terms.definition: Describes elements for packaging of FARE PRODUCTs for distribution.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::GROUP OF SALES OFFER PACKAGES
terms.definition: A grouping of SALES OFFER PACKAGEs. Notes: Identifier of GROUP of SALES OFFER PACKAGEs.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::SALES OFFER PACKAGE
terms.definition: A package to be sold as a whole, consisting of one or several FARE PRODUCTs materialised thanks to one or several TRAVEL DOCUMENTs. The FARE PRODUCTs may be either directly attached to the TRAVEL DOCUMENTs, or may be reloadable on the TRAVEL DOCUMENTs. Notes: Identifier of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT
terms.definition: The assignment of a FARE PRODUCT to a TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT in order to define a SALES OFFER PACKAGE, realised as a fixed assignment (printing, magnetic storage etc.) or by the possibility for the FARE PRODUCT to be reloaded on the TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT. Notes: Identifier of SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT. Notes: Number of media package in which package is available Notes: .Whether element requires validation before it can be used.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::SALES OFFER PACKAGE PRICE
terms.definition: A set of all possible price features of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE: default total price etc. Notes: Identifier of SALES OFFER PACKAGE PRICE.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::SALES OFFER PACKAGE SUBSTITUTION
terms.definition: Information on the preferred substitution of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE by another (or a set of others) if a quota restricted FARE PRODUCT is no longer available. Notes: Identifier of SALES OFFER PACKAGE SUBSTITUTION. Notes: Relative priority for substitution

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: An assignment of the COUNTRY and/or DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL through which a FARE PRODUCT may or may not be distributed. Notes: Whether distribution is allowed or forbidden by the specified DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL. Notes: Whether distribution is allowed or forbidden in the specified country. Notes: Description of DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT. Notes: Distribution by carrier of final leg of trip Notes: Identifier of a DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT. Notes: Distribution by carrier of first leg of trip Notes: Whether product is mandatory, Notes: Whether distribution requires the customer to register a personal identity either online or otherwise. Notes: Whether distribution is restricted to only the specified DISTRIBUTION CHANNELs. Notes: Distribution by carrier of middle of trip

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::SALES NOTICE ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: The assignment of a NOTICE to a SALES OFFER PACKAGE or a GROUP OF SALES OFFER PACKAGEs. Notes: Identifier of a SALES NOTICE ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::TYPE OF SALES OFFER PACKAGE
terms.definition: A classification of SALES OFFER PACKAGEs. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF SALES OFFER PACKAGE.

terms.label: SD Sales Offer Package MODEL::TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: A classification of DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENTs. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL
terms.definition: Describes distribution conditions on FARE PRODUCTs.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL
terms.definition: A type of outlet for selling of a FARE PRODUCT. Notes: Identifier of a DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL. Notes: Whether the option to use the channel is obligatory, that is, must be allowed. Notes: Whether to use the channel requires an email address.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::GROUP OF DISTRIBUTION CHANNELS
terms.definition: A grouping of DISTRIBUTION CHANNELs. Notes: Identifier of GROUP of DISTRIBUTION CHANNELs.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::FULFILMENT METHOD
terms.definition: The means by which the TRAVEL DOCUMENT is delivered to the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, e.g. online, collection, etc. Notes: Identifier of FULFILMENT METHOD. Notes: Whether collecting ticket requires booking reference. Notes: Whether collecting ticket requires credit card used to purchase.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::FULFILMENT METHOD PRICE
terms.definition: A set of all possible price features of a FULFILMENT METHOD default total price etc. Notes: Identifier of FULFILMENT METHOD PRICE.

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL
terms.definition: A classification of DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL, e.g. operator ticket office, onboard, self-service, third-party agent, etc. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL. TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL added instead of enum on DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION RIGHT
terms.definition: A classification of DISTRIBUTION RIGHTS, e.g. to sell, to exchange, to accept, etc. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION RIGHT. TYPE OF DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL added instead of enum on DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL

terms.label: SD Sales Distribution MODEL::TYPE OF FULFILMENT METHOD
terms.definition: A classification of FULFILMENT METHOD, e.g. email, print from online, collect, etc Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF FULFILMENT METHOD. TYPE OF FULFILMENT METHOD added isntead of enum on FULFILMENT METHOD

terms.definition: Describes packaging and materialisation of Fare products for distribution.

terms.label: SD Type of Travel Document MODEL::TYPE OF MACHINE READABILITY

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL
terms.definition: Describes electronic media used for the materialisation of fare products.

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE
terms.definition: A component (mobile phone, smart card, etc) with the necessary facilities (hardware and software) to host a MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE and communicate with a control device. Notes: Identifier of MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE. Notes: Secure token used to identify MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE. A particular physical evidence to be held by a PASSENGER, allowing the determination of the right to travel or to consume joint-services. May comprise just a token associated with an online account, or some form of representation of the access rights.

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::SMARTCARD
terms.definition: A smart card with the necessary facilities (hardware and software) are) to host a MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE and communicate with a control device. Notes: Identifier of SMARTCARD..

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::EMV CARD
terms.definition: A standardised payment card (Europay MasterCard Visa etc) , capable of being used as token for an ABT system Notes: Identifier of EMV CARD

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::MOBILE DEVICE
terms.definition: A mobile device (mobile phone, tablet, etc) with the necessary facilities (hardware and software) to host a MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE and communicate with a control device. Notes: Identifier of MOBILE DEVICE.

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE
terms.definition: Initialized instance of a software application that runs on a MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE. Notes: Identifier of MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE. Notes: Secure token used to identify MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE. Notes: Name of MEDIUM APPLICATION INSTANCE.

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::TYPE OF MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE
terms.definition: A classification of MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICEs. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE. A particular physical evidence to be held by a PASSENGER, allowing the determination of the right to travel or to consume joint-services. May comprise just a token associated with an online account, or some form of representation of the access rights.

terms.label: SD Medium Application MODEL::MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE SECURITY LISTING
terms.definition: The presence of an specific MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE on a SECURITY LIST. Notes: Identifier of a MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE SECURITY LISTING

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL
terms.definition: Describes the relationship with customer who buys fare products.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::TRANSPORT CUSTOMER
terms.definition: An specific person or organisation involved in a fare process. There may be a FARE CONTRACT between the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER and the OPERATOR or the AUTHORITY ruling the consumption of services. Notes: Date of Birth of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: First name of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Gender of TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Height of TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Photo of TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Surname of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Telephone number of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Title of address of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::CUSTOMER SECURITY LISTING
terms.definition: The presence of an specific TRANSPORT CUSTOMER on a SECURITY LIST. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER.SECURITY LISTING

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::CUSTOMER ACCOUNT
terms.definition: A registration of the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER with an ACCOUNT PROVIDER to obtain travel services. Notes: Creation date of CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Last modification date of CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Status of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::CUSTOMER ACCOUNT SECURITY LISTING
terms.definition: The presence of a specific CUSTOMER ACCOUNT on a SECURITY LIST. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER.ACCOUNT SECURITY LISTING

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::FARE CONTRACT
terms.definition: A contract with a particular (but possibly anonymous) customer, ruling the consumption of transport services (and joint services). A FARE CONTRACT may be designed for a fixed SALES OFFER PACKAGE (e.g. ticket) or to allow successive purchases of SALES OFFER PACKAGEs. Notes: Description of CONTRACT. Notes: Identifier of a FARE CONTRACT. Notes: Name of CONTRACT.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::FARE CONTRACT SECURITY LISTING
terms.definition: The presence of an specific FARE CONTRACT on a SECURITY LIST. . Notes: Identifier of a FARE CONTRACT.SECURITY LISTING

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::FARE CONTRACT ENTRY
terms.definition: An LOG ENTRY associated with of a FARE CONTRACT. Notes: Identifier of FARE CONTRACT ENTRY..

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::TYPE OF FARE CONTRACT ENTRY
terms.definition: A classification of FARE CONTRACT ENTRY. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF FARE CONTRACT EVENT.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::FARE CONTRACT STATUS
terms.definition: A classification of possible status of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, e.g. active, suspended, archived, etc. Notes: Identifier of FARE CONTRACT STATUS.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::TYPE OF CUSTOMER ACCOUNT
terms.definition: A classification of CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF CUSTOMER ACCOUNT.

terms.label: ST Fare Contract MODEL::TYPE OF FARE CONTRACT
terms.definition: A classification of FARE CONTRACT. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF FARE CONTRACT .

terms.label: ST Customer Eligibility MODEL
terms.definition: Describes the eligibility of a specific customer for the characteristics of FARE PRODUCTs.

terms.label: ST Customer Eligibility MODEL::CUSTOMER ELIGIBILITY
terms.definition: A parameter indicating whether a specific TRANSPORT CUSTOMER is eligible for a FARE PRODUCT with a specific validity parameter. This may be subject to a particular VALIDITY CONDITION. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER ELIGIBILITY.

terms.label: ST Customer Eligibility MODEL::USER PROFILE ELIGIBILITY
terms.definition: Whether a specific TRANSPORT CUSTOMER is eligible for a FARE PRODUCT with a specific USER PROFILE as a validity parameter. Notes: Identifier of a USER PROFILE ELIGIBILITY.

terms.label: ST Customer Eligibility MODEL::COMMERCIAL PROFILE ELIGIBILITY
terms.definition: A parameter indicating whether a specific TRANSPORT CUSTOMER is eligible for a FARE PRODUCT linked to a specific COMMERCIAL PROFILE. Notes: Identifier of a COMMERCIAL PROFILE ELIGIBILITY.

terms.label: ST Customer Eligibility MODEL::RESIDENTIAL ELIGIBILITY
terms.definition: Parameters indicating whether a specific TRANSPORT CUSTOMER is eligible for an access right with a specific RESIDENTIAL PROFILE as a validity parameter. Notes: Identifier of a RESIDENTIAL ELIGIBILITY.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL
terms.definition: Describes a record of sales of Fare products .

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::TRAVEL SPECIFICATION
terms.definition: A set of parameters giving details of an intended consumption of access rights by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER (e.g. origin and destination of a travel, class of travel, etc.). Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL SPECIFICATION.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::OFFERED TRAVEL SPECIFICATION
terms.definition: A set of parameters giving details of the intended consumption of access rights associated with a SALES PACKAGE OFFER or a CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE. (e.g. origin and destination of a travel, class of travel, etc.). Notes: Identifier of OFFERED TRAVEL SPECIFICATION.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::REQUESTED TRAVEL SPECIFICATION
terms.definition: A set of parameters giving details of an intended consumption of access rights requested by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER (e.g. origin and destination of a travel, class of travel, etc.). Notes: Identifier of REQUESTED TRAVEL SPECIFICATION.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE ELEMENT
terms.definition: A purchase of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, with an indication of all selected parameters. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE CHOICE.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE
terms.definition: A purchase of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, giving access rights corresponding to those of one or several FARE PRODUCTs materialised as one or several TRAVEL DOCUMENTs. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::CUSTOMER PURCHASE PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: A VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT specifying detailed parameters corresponding to a particular CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE, chosen from those available for a given fare structure (e.g. the origin or destination zone in a zone-counting system). Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER PURCHASE PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE PRICE
terms.definition: A specialisation of FARE PRICE that defines the price of a CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE PRICE.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::CUSTOMER PURCHASE STATUS
terms.definition: A classification of possible statuses of CUSTOMER PURCHASE PACKAGE, e.g. booked, paid for, consumed. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER PURCHASE STATUS.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::TRAVEL DOCUMENT
terms.definition: A particular physical evidence to be held by a passenger, (ticket, card, etc..) allowing the determination of the right to travel or to consume joint-services. May comprise just a token associated with an online account, or some form of representation of the access rights. Notes: Whether the TRAVEL DOCUMENT is currently deemed active. Notes: Description of TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT. Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL DOCUMENT. Notes: Secure token used to identify customer, May be anonymised. Notes: Name of TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::TRAVEL DOCUMENT SECURITY LISTING
terms.definition: The presence of an specific TRAVEL DOCUMENT on a SECURITY LIST. Notes: Identifier of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT SECURITY LISTING.

terms.label: ST Sales Transaction MODEL::SALES TRANSACTION
terms.definition: A sale of a SALES OFFER PACKAGE Notes: Amount of Transaction. Notes: End time of validity of product. Notes: Identifier of SALES TRANSACTION. Notes: Stat time of validity of product.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::FARE DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action in case of post-payment or value card debiting. Notes: Amount debited or credited. Notes: Identifier of FARE DEBIT.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::FARE PRODUCT SALE DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action in case of a FARE PRODUCT purchase, e.g. a product value card debiting. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT SALE DEBIT.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::TRIP DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action in case of post-payment for a specific trip. Notes: Identifier of TRIP DEBIT.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::BOOKING DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action for a booking fee. Notes: Identifier of BOOKING DEBIT.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::OFFENCE DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action in case of a fine for an offence or penalty fare. Notes: Identifier of OFFENCE DEBIT.

terms.label: ST Fare Sales Debit MODEL::OTHER DEBIT
terms.definition: A log entry providing data for a debiting action in case of other payment type than OFFENCE DEBIT or BOOKING DEBIT.. Notes: Identifier of OTHER DEBIT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EVENT
terms.definition: An action performed by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER relating to a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::CUSTOMER REGISTER EVENT
terms.definition: The registration by the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER for a new account. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER REGISTER EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::CUSTOMER DEREGISTER EVENT
terms.definition: The closing of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT and the removal of all personal details. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER DEREGISTER EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::CUSTOMER MODIFY PROFILE EVENT
terms.definition: The modification by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER of his CUSTOMER ACCOUNT details. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER MODIFY PROFILE EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::CUSTOMER REGISTER MEDIA EVENT
terms.definition: The registration of a specific MEDIA instance such as an EMV card against a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER REGISTER MEDIA EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Use Event MODEL::RESTORE CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EVENT
terms.definition: The reinstallation to replacement media of an electronic travel document by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER on a MEDIA DEVICE, usually as a MEDIA APPLICATION, possibly with recovered stored value. Notes: Identifier of RESTORE CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EVENT.

terms.definition: An abstract FARE CONTRACT ENTRY relating to a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER REGISTRATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the registration of a CUSTOMER and the creating of a new account. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER REGISTRATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER PROFILE MODIFICATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the updating of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER's account information. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER PROFILE MODIFICATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER DEREGISTRATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the closing of an account and the clearing from record of all personal details of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER DEREGISTRATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER MEDIA REGISTRATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the registration of a media item against a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, such as an EMV card as a payment method for the account. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER MEDIA REGISTRATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Account Log Entry MODEL::RESTORE CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the restoration of an CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of a RESTORE CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::ACCOUNT SECURITY EVENT
terms.definition: A securty event initiated by the processing of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT by an ABT System. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT SECURITY EVENT.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::ALLOW ACCOUNT ON SECURITY LIST EVENT
terms.definition: The granting of rights by placing an ENTITY on a WHITE LIST and/or removing it from a BLACK LIST. Notes: Identifier of ALLOW ACCOUNT ON SECURITY LIST EVENT. ..

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::DENY ACCOUNT ON SECURITY LIST EVENT
terms.definition: The denial of rights by placing an ENTITY on a BLACK LIST and/or removing it from a WHITE LIST. Notes: Identifier of DENY ACCOUNT ON SECURITY LIST EVENT.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::ACCOUNT SUSPEND EVENT
terms.definition: The suspension of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT SUSPEND EVENT. ..

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::ACCOUNT REVIVE EVENT
terms.definition: The reinstatement of a suspended CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT REVIVE EVENT.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT ELIGIBILITY CHANGE EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System of a change in the eligibility of a user for a product they currently own, requiring an adjustment of some sort. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT DETECT ELIGIBILITY CHANGE EVENT.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::SECURITY LIST ENTRY
terms.definition: An abstract FARE CONTRACT ENTRY relating to measures to enforce Revenue Protection. Notes: Identifier of REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::SECURITY LIST ALLOW ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the granting of access to the network by the addition to a WHITE LIST or removal from a BLACK LIST of a token that identifies of an ENTITY such as a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, FARE CONTRACT, TRAVEL DOCUMENT, etc. Notes: Identifier of SECURITY LIST ALLOW ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::SECURITY LIST DENY ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the denying of access to the transport network by the addition to a BLACK LIST or removal from a WHITE LIST of a token that identifies a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, FARE CONTRACT, TRAVEL DOCUMENT, etc Notes: Identifier of SECURITY LIST DENY ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::ACCOUNT SUSPEND ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the denying of access to the transport network by the addition to a BLACK LIST or removal from a WHITE LIST of a token that identifies a CUSTOMER, CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, FARE CONTRACT, TRAVEL DOCUMENT, etc. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT SUSPEND ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::ACCOUNT REVIVE ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the reinstatement of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT REVIVE ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::BECOMES ELIGIBLE ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the detection that a user has become eligible for a product for which they were previously ineligible, e.g. by virtue of growing older, changing employment status, or residence. Notes: Identifier of BECOMES ELIGIBLE ENTRY.

terms.label: FM FE Account Security Log Entry MODEL::CEASES TO BE ELIGIBLE ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ENTRY recording the detection that a user has ceased to be eligible for a product for which they were previously eligible, e.g. by virtue of growing older, changing employment status, or residence. Notes: Identifier of CEASES TO BE ELIGIBLE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Event MODEL::CUSTOMER PRODUCT PURCHASE EVENT
terms.definition: The purchase of a FARE PRODUCT by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER PRODUCT PURCHASE EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Event MODEL::CUSTOMER EXCHANGE EVENT
terms.definition: The exchange by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER of a product for another product. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER EXCHANGE EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Event MODEL::CUSTOMER REFUND EVENT
terms.definition: The giving of a refund to a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER for a product previously purchased. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER REFUND EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Event MODEL::CUSTOMER BOOKING EVENT
terms.definition: The booking or modification of a reservation by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, possibly without purchase. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER BOOKING EVENT.

terms.label: SE Account Sales Event MODEL::ACCOUNT AUTO RENEWAL EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System that a renewable product such as a pass needs to be renewed. Depending on configuration may trigger either an automatic renewal or a notice to the customer. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT AUTO RENEWAL EVENT.

terms.label: SE Account Sales Event MODEL::ACCOUNT AUTO TOP UP EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System that the account balance has fallen below a threshold which needs to be topped up using a preset payment method and increment. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT AUTO TOP UP EVENT.

terms.label: SE Account Sales Event MODEL::ACCOUNT AWARD REFUND EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System that a refund needs to be awarded, for example because guaranteed performance targets have not been met Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT AWARD REFUND EVENT.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL
terms.definition: Description of retail entries that take place through customer interaction with fare management system.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER PRODUCT PURCHASE ENTRY
terms.definition: An abstract SALES TRANSACTION recording a purchase of any sort by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER PRODUCT PURCHASE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER BOOKING ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording the reservation of an access right. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER BOOKING EBTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::CUSTOMER BOOKING CANCELLATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording the cancellation of a reservation. Notes: Identifier of a CUSTOMER BOOKING CANCELLATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::FARE PRODUCT PURCHASE ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER PURCHASE ENTRY recording the purchase of a FARE PRODUCT by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a FARE PRODUCT PURCHASE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::TRIP PURCHASE ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER PURCHASE ENTRY recording the purchase of a single trip FARE PRODUCT by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER.. Notes: Identifier of a TRIP PURCHASE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA RECHARGE PURCHASE ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording the purchase of a recharge of stored value by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a MEDIA RECHARGE PURCHASE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::FARE PRODUCT RENEWAL ENTRY
terms.definition: A CUSTOMER PRODUCT PURCHASE ENTRY recording the renewal of a FARE PRODUCT such as a pass by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of a FARE PRODUCT RENEWAL ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::FARE PRODUCT EXCHANGE ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording the alteration or exchange of a FARE PRODUCT for another by a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT EXCHANGE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::FARE PRODUCT REFUND ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording a refund given to a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT REFUND ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Customer Purchase Log Entry MODEL::TRAVEL COMPENSATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A SALES TRANSACTION recording the payment to the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER of compensation for some service shortcoming. Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL COMPENSATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER FULFILMENT EVENT
terms.definition: The delivery to a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER of a materialisation of a FARE PRODUCT as a TRAVEL DOCUMENT. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER FULFILLMENT EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER COLLECT EVENT
terms.definition: The collection by the TRANSPORT CUSTOMER of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT and/or MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE from any FULFILMENT CHANNEL. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER COLLECT EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER MEDIA INSTALL EVENT
terms.definition: The installation of an electronic travel document on a MEDIA DEVICE, usually as a MEDIA APPLICATION. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER MEDIA INSTALL EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER MEDIA RESTORE EVENT
terms.definition: The replacement of an electronic MEDIA DEVICE. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER MEDIA RESTORE EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER MEDIA APPLICATION RESTORE EVENT
terms.definition: The reinstallation to replacement media of an electronic travel document on a MEDIA DEVICE, usually as a MEDIA APPLICATION, possibly with recovered stored value. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER MEDIA APPLICATION RESTORE EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Event MODEL::CUSTOMER PRODUCT ACTIVATION EVENT
terms.definition: The activation of a FARE PRODUCT, e.g. on an installed MEDIA or for a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT. Notes: Identifier of CUSTOMER PRODUCT ACTIVATION EVENT.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL
terms.definition: Description of fulfilment events that take place through customer interaction with fare management system.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::FULFILMENT ENTRY
terms.definition: An abstract FARE CONTRACT ENTRY relating to delivery of a purchase. Notes: Identifier of a FULFILMENT ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::TRAVEL DOCUMENT COLLECTION ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the physical delivery of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT to a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER, for example from a ticket on demand machine at a station, or internet self service. Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL DOCUMENT COLLECTION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::PURCHASE FULFILMENT ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the delivery of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT to a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER by any means, for example by email, SMS or download Notes: Identifier of PURCHASE FULFILLMENT ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA APPLICATION RESTORE ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the reinstallation of a previously purchased application on a MEDIA ACCESS DEVICE, possibly with the recovery of value. Notes: Identifier of MEDIA APPLICATION RESTORE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA PRODUCT INSTALLATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the installation of a previously purchased product on a MEDIA ACCESS DEVICE. Notes: Identifier of MEDIA PRODUCT INSTALLATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA RESTORE ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the replacement of the MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE. Notes: Identifier of MEDIA RESTORE ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA PRODUCT ACTIVATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the activation of a previously purchased or installed product. Might for example also involve placing on a WHITE LIST. Notes: Identifier of a MEDIA PRODUCT ACTIVATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::MEDIA PRODUCT DEACTIVATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the deactivation of a previously purchased or installed product. Notes: Identifier of MEDIUM PRODUCT DEACTIVATION ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::ADJUST BALANCE ON CHECK IN ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the adjustment of the balance from an amount deposited on account on a MEDIUM ACCESS DEVICE when a passenger checks in or interacts with a system. Notes: Identifier of an ADJUST BALANCE ON CHECK IN ENTRY.

terms.label: SE Sales Fulfilment Log Entry MODEL::TRAVEL DOCUMENT ANNULMENT ENTRY
terms.definition: A FULFILMENT ENTRY recording the annulment of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT so that it may no longer be used. Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL DOCUMENT CANCELLATION ENTRY.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL
terms.definition: The Fare Management Role model describes the corporate actors who provide transport services.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE ORGANISATION ROLE
terms.definition: Any corporate role in providing or managing transport services. Notes: Identifier of FARE ORGANISATION ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE PRODUCT OWNER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of the organisation which has commercial ownership of a FARE PRODUCT and is responsible for specifying pricing, usage conditions and commercial rules for the product, for ensuring there are processes for marketing and retailing the product, customer payment, control and validation, back office accounting and settlement and for customer service. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT OWNER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE PRODUCT DISTRIBUTOR ROLE
terms.definition: The role, in large networks, of organising and accounting for the wholesale distribution of FARE PRODUCTs, as delegated by the FARE PRODUCT OWNER ROLE and to supply products to the FARE PRODUCT RETAILER ROLE. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT DISTRIBUTOR ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE PRODUCT ISSUER ROLE
terms.definition: A role of an organisation introduced when there are a large number of fare product owners and a large number of distributors. The FARE PRODUCT ISSUER ROLE makes a portfolio of products available to a product distributor to be sold via product retailers to TRANSPORT CUSTOMERs. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT ISSUER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE PRODUCT ATTRIBUTOR ROLE
terms.definition: The role of being an agent of a FARE PRODUCT OWNER, i.e. the role of an intermediary organisation to whom certain responsibilities have been delegated by the FARE PRODUCT OWNER, for instance to provide the technical implementation of the products defined by the FARE PRODUCT OWNER. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT ATTRIBUTOR ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE PRODUCT RETAILER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of an organisation to sell products to TRANSPORT CUSTOMERs, as authorised by a FARE PRODUCT OWNER ROLE. The FARE PRODUCT RETAILER ROLE may be undertaken by the same party as the FARE PRODUCT OWNER ROLE, the ACCOUNT PROVIDER ROLE, or a secondary outlet such as a TRAVEL AGENT or, newsagent, or other third party, etc. Notes: Identifier of FARE PRODUCT RETAILER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE DATA COLLECTOR ROLE
terms.definition: The role of collecting and forwarding fare data between the various parties concerned with product delivery, such as PRODUCT RETAILER, PRODUCT OWNER etc. May be undertaken by a separate intermediary. Notes: Identifier of DATA COLLECTOR.

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE REGISTRAR ROLE
terms.definition: The ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANISATION ROLE of coordinating the issue of unique registration codes (for example, by determining rules for generating unique codes) for data linked to fare management such as FARE CONTRACTs, TRAVEL DOCUMENTs, etc. Notes: Identifier of FARE REGISTRAR ROLE

terms.label: FR Fare Management Role MODEL::FARE SECURITY MANAGER ROLE
terms.definition: The ADMINISTRATIVE ORGANISATION ROLE of establishing and coordinating a security policy for fare data across the provider organisations, and of the certifying and auditing of organisations, applications, etc for their conformance to the security policy. Notes: Identifier of FARE SECURITY MANAGER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::MEDIUM APPLICATION OWNER ROLE
terms.definition: For media-centric products, the APPLICATION OWNER ROLE has commercial ownership of the software MEDIA APPLICATION hosting a product and is contracted by the PRODUCT OWNER for the use of the application with the customer. Notes: Identifier of MEDIUM APPLICATION OWNER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::MEDIUM APPLICATION PROVIDER ROLE
terms.definition: For media-centric products, the APPLICATION PROVIDER supplies the software application that hosts a TRAVEL DOCUMENT and presents it to CONTROL DEVICEs for automatic control and validation. Notes: Identifier of MEDIUM APPLICATION PROVIDER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::ACCOUNT PROVIDER ROLE
terms.definition: In Account Based Ticketing, the ACCOUNT PROVIDER provides the online account by means of which the product is delivered. Normally this involves a direct relationship with the CUSTOMER, though it may also be done as a white-labelled service for a another party Notes: Identifier of MANAGEMENT AGENT.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::IDENTITY PROVIDER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of supplying a trusted identity token that can be associated with a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, TRAVEL DOCUMENT, etc. The IDENTITY PROVIDER ROLE may be undertaken by transport AUTHORITies and OPERATORs , but also non-transport organisations such as governments central and local, mobile network operators, or online service providers (e,g. Google, Facebook) and banks. Notes: Identifier of IDENTITY PROVIDER.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::MEDIA PROVIDER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of supplying the media used for the TRAVEL DOCUMENT, that is a physical support containing a machine readable/writable data/processor application. This can include transport industry smartcards, payment industry contactless cards, public sector issued cards, mobile phones or paper (for barcodes), new formats such as watches and key fobs, and NFC enabled devices. Notes: Identifier of MEDIA PROVIDER.

terms.label: FR Fare Technology Role MODEL::PAYMENT PROVIDER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of channelling funds from the CUSTOMER to the FARE PRODUCT RETAILER for travel services, and particularly for usage-based travel products. For example EMV provider, ApplePay, PayPal, Android PAy, etc Notes: Identifier of PAYMENT PROVIDER.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL
terms.definition: The Fare User Role model describes the human actors who use transport services.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::PURCHASER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of the party who pays for a travel service for one or more TRANSPORT CUSTOMERs.. Notes: Identifier of PURCHASER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::INDIVIDUAL PURCHASER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of a person in purchasing a FARE PRODUCT as a private individual. Often, but not necessarily the same as the PASSENGER ROLE. Notes: Identifier of INDIVIDUAL PURCHASER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::CORPORATE PURCHASER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of purchasing FARE PRODUCTs on behalf of a corporate body such as a company, school, government department, etc. Notes: Identifier of CORPORATE PURCHASER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::PASSENGER ROLE
terms.definition: The general role of consuming a travel service. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::INDIVIDUAL PASSENGER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of a passenger consuming a travel service as a single individual. Notes: Identifier of INDIVIDUAL PASSENGER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::COMPANION ROLE
terms.definition: The role of accompanying another PASSENGER under the access rights granted by the other PASSENGER's ticket. Notes: Identifier of COMPANION ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::OFFENDER ROLE
terms.definition: The role enacted by someone attempting to travel with no or insufficient access rights. Notes: Identifier of OFFENDER ROLE.

terms.label: FR Fare Transport Customer Role MODEL::GROUP MEMBER ROLE
terms.definition: The role of a passenger travelling under the access rights granted by a GROUP TICKET. Notes: Identifier of GROUP MEMBER ROLE.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL
terms.definition: Description of the available means and devices with which validation and control of fares may be undertaken.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::CONTROL MEANS
terms.definition: A particular means (control device or manual control procedure) used to control TRAVEL DOCUMENTs. Notes: Identifier of CONTROL MEANS.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::DEVICE RELATED CONTROL MEANS
terms.definition: A specific device constituting the CONTROL MEANS to control TRAVEL DOCUMENTs. Notes: Identifier of a DEVICE RELATED CONTROL MEANS..

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::OTHER CONTROL MEANS
terms.definition: A particular means other than a control device, for example a manual procedure, used to control apply control processes. Notes: Identifier of OTHER CONTROL MEANS.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::CONTROL TYPE
terms.definition: A classification of passenger controls, e.g. entry, exit, en route or occasional controls. Notes: Identifier of CONTROL TYPE.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::DEVICE PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: An ACCESS RIGHT PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT expressing the location (or other fixed parameters) of a CONTROL MEANS. Notes: Identifier of DEVICE PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: FC Control Means MODEL::TYPE OF OFFENCE
terms.definition: A classification of OFFENCE, for example wrong CLASS OF SEAT, not valid for PRODUCT CATEGORY, etc. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF OFFENCE.

terms.label: FC Validation and Control MODEL
terms.definition: Describes the control and validation of passengers with fare products.

terms.label: FC Access Right Control MODEL::CONTROL RECORD
terms.definition: A log entry providing general audit properties of a validation or control action. Notes: Identifier of CONTROLRECORD.

terms.label: FC Access Right Control MODEL::CONTROL ENTRY
terms.definition: The description of a control action, i.e. the comparison of actual and current parameters (time, location, ...) to the access rights to which the holder of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT is entitled. Notes: Identifier of CONTROL ENTRY.

terms.label: FC Access Right Control MODEL::CONTROLLED ACCESS
terms.definition: A validated use of a CONTROLLABLE ELEMENT. Notes: Identifier of CONTROLLED ACCESS..

terms.label: FC Access Right Control MODEL::CONTROL PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: An ACCESS RIGHT PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT relating a fare collection parameter to a CONTROL ENTRY. Notes: Identifier of CONTROL PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL
terms.definition: Description of control and validation record created by customer interaction.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL::VALIDATION ENTRY
terms.definition: The result of the comparison between one or several CONTROL ENTRies and the theoretical access rights attached to the TRAVEL DOCUMENT controlled, validating the right to consume and possibly providing a DEBIT or one or more OFFENCEs. Notes: Identifier of VALIDATION ENTRY. Notes: Whether the validation was successful or refused.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL::VALIDATED ACCESS
terms.definition: A validated use of a VALIDABLE ELEMENT, composed of ACCESSED FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs. Notes: Identifier of VALIDATED ACCESS.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL::ACCESSED FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT
terms.definition: A validated use of a FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT, composed of CONTROLLED ACCESSes. Notes: Identifier of ACCESSED FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL::VALIDATION PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: An ACCESS RIGHT PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT relating a fare collection parameter to a VALIDATED ACCESS or one of its components. Notes: Identifier of VALIDATION PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: FC Access Right Validation MODEL::OFFENCE
terms.definition: A log entry providing data on a violation of fare rules. Notes: Whether the user's TRAVEL DOCUMENT has been retained as a consequence of the offence. Notes: Whether a fine has been issued for the offence. Notes: Identifier of OFFENCE.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::PASSENGER TRAVEL CONTROL EVENT
terms.definition: Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER TRAVEL CONTROL EVENT.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::PASSENGER ACTIVATE TRIP EVENT
terms.definition: A passenger action to initiate the consumption of access rights, usually at the start of a trip, for example by stamping a ticket at a validator device, or by an online interaction. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER ACTIVATE TRIP EVENT.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::PASSENGER CHECK IN EVENT
terms.definition: A passenger action to check in at the start of a trip. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER CHECK IN EVENT.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::PASSENGER CHECK OUT EVENT
terms.definition: A passenger action to check out at the end of a trip. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER CHECK OUT EVENT.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::PASSENGER WAY POINT EVENT
terms.definition: A passenger action to check in at a way point along a trip. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER WAY POINT EVENT.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Event MODEL::CONTROL PASSENGER TRIP EVENT
terms.definition: The control of the consumption of access rights by the inspection of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT by a travel document inspector . Notes: Identifier of CONTROL PASSENGER TRIP.EVENT..

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL
terms.definition: Description of PASSENGER CONTROL ENTRies that result from customer travel.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY
terms.definition: An abstract VALIDATION ENTRY relating to control of the PASSENGER. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::PASSENGER CHECK IN ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the check in of a passenger at a barrier or validation point at the start of a journey. May trigger prepayment. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER CHECK IN ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::PASSENGER CHECK OUT ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the check out of a passenger at a barrier or exit validation point. May trigger post payment. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER CHECK OUT ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::PASSENGER WAY POINT ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording a passenger checking in at a way point while in a trip so as to indicate travel by a specific itinerary. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER WAY POINT ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::CONTROL PASSENGER TRIP ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the control of the consumption of access rights by the inspection of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT by a TRAVEL DOCUMENT CONTROLLER. May include marking (cancellation) of the TRAVEL DOCUMENT. Notes: Identifier of CONTROL PASSENGER TRIP ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Passenger Travel Control Log Entry MODEL::FARE TRIP ACTIVATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the initiation of the consumption of access rights by a PASSENGER making a trip, for example by means of marking a TRAVEL DOCUMENT using a ticket validator machine. Notes: Identifier of FARE TRIP ACTIVATION ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Travel Match Log Entry MODEL::UNMATCHED TRAVEL ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the detection that an incompletely recorded trip has been detected. Notes: Identifier of UNMATCHED TRAVEL ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Travel Match Log Entry MODEL::NO CHECK IN DETECTED ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the detection that a passenger has failed to check in at the end of a journey. This may be triggered by a subsequent check in or by back office processes looking for unmatched waypoint check in and check out events within a specified window. Notes: Identifier of NO CHECK IN DETECTED ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Travel Match Log Entry MODEL::NO CHECK OUT DETECTED ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the detection that a passenger has failed to check out at the end of a journey. This may be triggered by a subsequent check in or by back office processes looking for unmatched check in and check out events within a specified window. Notes: Identifier of NO CHECKOUT DETECTION ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Travel Match Log Entry MODEL::PASSENGER USED SAME STOP ENTRY
terms.definition: A PASSENGER TRAVEL ENTRY recording the detection of a passenger re-entering a station within a threshold period. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER USED SAME STOP ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT PROCESSING EVENT
terms.definition: An event initiated by the processing of a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT by an ABT System. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT PROCESSING EVENT.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT TRIP EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System of a trip made by the user that needs to be accounted for. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT DETECT TRIP EVENT.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT NO CHECK IN EVENT
terms.definition: The detection that a passenger has failed to check in at the beginning of a trip. This may be triggered by a subsequent check out or by back office processes looking for unmatched check in and check out events within a specified window. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT DETECT NO CHECK IN EVENT.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT NO CHECK OUT EVENT
terms.definition: The detection that a passenger has failed to check out at the end of a trip. This may be triggered by a subsequent check in on a new journey or by back office processes looking for unmatched check in and check out events within a specified window.. Notes: Identifier of PASSENGER DETECT NO CHECK OUT EVENT.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT REENTRY EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System of reentry at the same station within a specified threshold period. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT DETECT RE-ENTRY EVENT.

terms.label: FE Account Processing Event MODEL::ACCOUNT DETECT SUSPICIOUS BEHAVIOUR EVENT
terms.definition: The detection by an ABT System of suspicious or fraudulent use of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT, for example being used in two different places at the same time. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT DETECT SUSPICIOUS BEHAVIOUR EVENT.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL
terms.definition: Description of revenue protection entries that take place through customer interaction with a fare management system.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY
terms.definition: An abstract FARE CONTRACT ENTRY relating to measures to enforce revenue protection. Notes: Identifier of REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::NO ACCESS RIGHTS ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the detection of a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER travelling without having purchased access rights Notes: Identifier of NO ACCESS RIGHTS ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::INSUFFICIENT ACCESS RIGHTS ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the result of the comparison between one or several CONTROL ENTRies and the theoretical access rights attached to the TRAVEL DOCUMENT controlled, detecting insufficient rights to consume and possibly giving rise to a FARE DEBIT or one or more OFFENCEs. Notes: Identifier of INSUFFICIENT ACCESS RIGHTS ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::NO PROOF ON PERSON ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the detection of a customer who claims to have purchased access rights but has no proof, e.g. TRAVEL DOCUMENT on their person. Notes: Identifier of NO PROOF ON PERSON ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::SUSPICIOUS BEHAVIOUR ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION EVENT recording the detection of suspicious behaviour. Notes: Identifier of SUSPICIOUS BEHAVIOUR ENTRY.

terms.label: FE Revenue Protection Log Entry MODEL::TRAVEL DOCUMENT CONFISCATION ENTRY
terms.definition: A REVENUE PROTECTION ENTRY recording the confiscation of a TRAVEL DOCUMENT from a TRANSPORT CUSTOMER because of an OFFENCE. Notes: Identifier of TRAVEL DOCUMENT CONFISCATION ENTRY.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::TRIP
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN describing the movement of a passenger from one PLACE of any sort to another. A TRIP may consist of one or more consecutive LEGs having some common characteristics. Notes: Identifier of PT TRIP.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::TRIP PATTERN
terms.definition: A movement of a passenger (or another person, e.g. driver) from an origin to a destination PLACE, done for a specific TRIP REASON. A TRIP PATTERN may consist of one or more consecutive TRIPs . Notes: Total distance for trip Notes: Time at which trip ends Notes: Identifier of TRIP PATTERN. Notes: Whether trip is provided by a single or multiple opertaors. Notes: Time at which trip starts

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::PT TRIP
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN starting from the first boarding of a public transport vehicle to the last alighting . A PT TRIP consist of one or more PT RIDEs and the movement, usually walks, necessary to cover the corresponding CONNECTIONs, described as PT CONNECTION LEGs. Notes: Identifier of PT TRIP.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::MIXED TRIP
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN from one PLACE of any sort to another. A MIXED TRIP may consist of two or more consecutive LEGs of both PT and non PT modes, having some common characteristics. Notes: Identifier of MIXED TRIP.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::NON-PT TRIP
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN from one PLACE of any sort to another, made on means other than Public Transport. A NON-PT TRIP may consist of consecutive ACCESS LEGs or OTHER LEGs. Notes: Identifier of NON PT TRIP.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::LEG
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a user in a single vehicle, or a pedestrian mode such as walking. Notes: Total distance for LEG.. Notes: Duration of LEG. Notes: Identifier of LEG.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::PT RIDE LEG
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a user (passenger, driver) on one and only one public transport vehicle, from one SCHEDULED STOP POINT to another, on one JOURNEY PATTERN. Notes: Identifier of PT RIDE LEG.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::ACCESS LEG
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a passenger when not on a public transport vehicle, from an origin PLACE to a SCHEDULED STOP POINT, or a SCHEDULED STOP POINT to a destination PLACE. May reference an ACCESS. Notes: Identifier of ACCESS LEG.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::OTHER LEG
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a user (passenger, driver) on a non-PT mode from one PLACE to another and that is not an ACCESS LEG or a PT CONNECTION LEG. Notes: Identifier of OTHER LEG..

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::PT CONNECTION LEG
terms.definition: A part of a TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a passenger transferring from one SERVICE JOURNEY to another, made over a CONNECTION from one SCHEDULED STOP POINT to another, and possibly following a specific NAVIGATION PATH . Notes: Time needed to make interchange. Notes: Identifier of PT CONNECTION LEG.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::LEG TRACK
terms.definition: The spatial projection of the leg as set of coordinate points for a specific purpose., such as displaying it on a map. Notes: Identifier of LEG TRACK

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::PATH GUIDANCE
terms.definition: An instruction to a passenger for an individual step when following a path to interchange between two SCHEDULED STOP POINTs at a CONNECTION. Notes: Description of PATH STEP INSTRUCTION. E.g. Turn left at fork.. Notes: Heading instruction relative to point declared 'left', 'right' onwards, etc. Notes: Identifier of PATH GUIDANCE. Notes: Order of PATH GUIDANCE within RIDE INTERCHANEG LEG.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::TYPE OF GUARANTEE
terms.definition: A classification of the type of guarantee offered for a given leg. Notes: Identifier of TYPE of GUARANTEE.

terms.label: TD Passenger Trip MODEL::TRIP REASON
terms.definition: A classification of a passenger's reason for undertaking a TRIP PATTERN, e.g. work commute, school pick up, shopping, etc.. Notes: Identifier of TRIP REASON.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::TRIP PATTERN MONITORING
terms.definition: Real-time monitoring of a passenger movement to provide progress information for a passenger. Notes: Identifier of TRIP PATTERN MONITORING.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED TRIP PATTERN
terms.definition: A monitored passenger movement from an origin to a destination PLACE, consisting of one or more MONITORED LEGs undertaken in sequence. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED TRIP.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG
terms.definition: A part of a MONITORED TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a user in a single vehicle, or a pedestrian mode such as walking. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED LEG.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED TRIP
terms.definition: A part of a MONITORED TRIP PATTERN corresponding to the movement of a passenger from one PLACE of any sort to another in any one mode. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED LEG.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG PROGRESS
terms.definition: The relative progress of a passenger along a LEG. Notes: Distance along current LINK... Notes: Time at which leg was ended. Notes: Current Distance along LEG.. Notes: Time at which leg is/was started

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG CALL
terms.definition: Data to present to a passenger making a specific MONITORED TRIP relating to the status of a individual visit by a VEHICLE JOURNEY to a POINT IN JOURNEY PATTERN. May be for origin, destination , and intermediate points. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED LEG CALL.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG ARRIVAL
terms.definition: A view that brings together data to present to a passenger making a specific MONITORED TRIP relating to the arrival at a POINT IN JOURNEY PATTERN of a DATED VEHICLE JOURNEY.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG CALL PART
terms.definition: A view that brings together data to present to a passenger making a specific MONITORED TRIP relating to the arrival to or the departure from a POINT IN JOURNEY PATTERN in a DATED VEHICLE JOURNEY. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED LEG CALL PART.

terms.label: TD Monitored Trip MODEL::MONITORED LEG DEPARTURE
terms.definition: A view that brings together data to present to the passenger making a specific MONITORED TRIP relating to the departure from a POINT IN JOURNEY PATTERN in a DATED VEHICLE JOURNEY. Notes: Identifier of MONITORED LEG DEPARTURE.

terms.label: TD Trip Duration MODEL::MEAN PASSENGER WAIT TIME
terms.definition: An estimated mean waiting time for a passenger at a SCHEDULED STOP POINT, used to calculate the approximate duration of a trip.This value is estimated from the mean interval between vehicles on a JOURNEY PATTERN or a COMMON SECTION. Notes: Identifier of MEAN PASSENGER WAIT TIME.

terms.label: TD Trip Duration MODEL::MEAN RUN TIME
terms.definition: An estimated value of the mean run time on a TIMING LINK, used to inform passengers on the mean duration of trips. Notes: Identifier of MEAN RUN TIME.

terms.label: TD Trip Duration MODEL::MEAN INTERCHANGE TIME
terms.definition: An estimated value of the mean time to make an INTERCHANGE, used to inform passengers on the mean duration of trips. May be derived from low level breakdown. Notes: Identifier of MEAN INTERCHANGE TIME.

terms.label: QR Trip Query MODEL::TRIP REQUEST POLICY
terms.definition: Optimisation criteria to be used to when computing and decorating trip plans. Notes: Whether the trip calculation should find a solution that starts immediately (eg: because the user is already on the way) instead of finding the latest possible start opportunity. Notes: Whether Accessibility details are to be included. Notes: Whether results should include information about fares. Notes: Whether results should include information about intermediate CALLs that the journey makes between the trip start and end. Notes: Whether results should include information about the origin and destination of a vehicle journey if it starts before the SCHEDULED STOP POINT at which the passenger boards or ends beyond the SCHEDULED STOP POINT at which the passenger alights. Notes: Whether results should include a plot of the legs. Notes: Whether the results should include information about the days on which a service operates. Notes: Whether results should include a plot of the trip. Notes: Whether results should include information about SITUATIONS affecting trip. Notes: Whether step by step turn descriptions are to be provided. Notes: Maximum number of journeys to include in results. Notes: How to optimize the query. Notes: Whether plan should use real-time data if available and if relevant.

terms.label: QR Trip Query MODEL::TRIP DESTINATION PLACE
terms.definition: A destination location for a TRIP REQUEST. Notes: Identifier of TRIP DESTINATION PLACE.

terms.label: QR Trip Query MODEL::TRIP VIA PLACE
terms.definition: A routing location used to constrain the journeys returned. Only VEHICLE JOURNEYs whose JOURNEY PATTERNs do or do not pass through the specified points will be returned. Notes: Whether VIA point can be used to interchange or is forbidden for interchange. Notes: Whether VIa point is to be taken or avoided ("not via"). Notes: Identifier of TRIP VIA PLACE.

terms.label: QR Trip Query MODEL::TRIP ACCESS CONSTRAINT

terms.label: DM Duty MODEL::ASSIGNED DUTY
terms.definition: An ASSIGNED DUTY is a DUTY to which specific timed work has been assigned. Notes: Identifier of ASSIGNED DUTY.

terms.label: DM Duty MODEL::DUTY
terms.definition: A DUTY describes the work to be performed by a driver on a particular DAY TYPE. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to bring the DUTY to an end. Notes: Identifier of DUTY. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to get ready to start the DUTY.

terms.label: DM Duty MODEL::DUTY PART
terms.definition: A DUTY PART is a continuous part of a driver DUTY during which the driver is under the management of the company and may include BREAKs. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this DUTY PART. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this DUTY PART. Notes: Time allotted for driver to access DUTY PART. Notes: Time allotted for driver to return from DUTY PART. Notes: End time of DUTY PART. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to bring the DUTY PART to an end. Notes: Identifier of DUTY PART. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to get ready to start the DUTY PART. Notes: Start time of DUTY PART.

terms.label: DM Duty MODEL::SPARE DUTY
terms.definition: A SPARE DUTY is a DUTY to which specific timed work has not yet been assigned. Notes: Identifier of SPARE DUTY.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::BREAK
terms.definition: A BREAK is a period of time within a DUTY PART during which the driver is not responsible for a vehicle and can rest, usually at a BREAK FACILITY. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this BREAK. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this BREAK. Notes: Duration of BREAK. Notes: Identifier of BREAK.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::BREAK FACILITY
terms.definition: A BREAK FACILITY is a canteen, cafe, kiosk or any place where drivers have toilet and refreshment facilities. Notes: Identifier of BREAk FACILITY. Notes: Name of BREAK FACILITY.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::DRIVING SPELL
terms.definition: A DRIVING SPELL is a continuous period in a STRETCH, during which a driver is on duty in one vehicle. Notes: Identifier of DRIVING SPELL.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::NON-DRIVING SPELL
terms.definition: A NON DRIVING SPELL is a continuous period in a STRETCH when a driver is performing some non-driving TASK or waiting on STAND-BY. Notes: Finishing time of a NON-DRIVING SPELL Notes: Identifier of NON-DRIVING SPELL. Notes: Start time of a NON-DRIVING SPELL

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::PAUSE
terms.definition: A PAUSE is a period of paid driver time at the end of a SERVICE JOURNEY or during or after a DEAD RUN when the driver is responsible for the VEHICLE, but resting in the VEHICLE or in a designated BREAK FACILITY near the POINT where the VEHICLE has stopped. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this PAUSE. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this PAUSE. Notes: Duration of PAUSE. Notes: Identifier of PAUSE.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::SPELL
terms.definition: A SPELL is a continuous period in a STRETCH, when a driver is on duty on one vehicle or performing one other type of work. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this SPELL. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this SPELL. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to bring the SPELL to an end. Notes: Identifier of SPELL. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to get ready to start the SPELL.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::STAND-BY
terms.definition: A STAND-BY is a non-driving period of a driver's DUTY when the driver must wait ready to take on any specified piece of work instantly. Notes: Identifier of STAND-BY.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::STRETCH
terms.definition: A STRETCH is a period of a driver's DUTY during which the driver is continuously working without a BREAK but that may include PAUSEs during which the driver remains responsible for the vehicle. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this STRETCH. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this STRETCH. Notes: End time of STRETCH. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to bring the STRETCH to an end. Notes: Identifier of STRETCH. Notes: Time allotted for activities required to get ready to start the STRETCH. Notes: Start time of STRETCH.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::TASK
terms.definition: A TASK is any continuous piece of non-driving work, performed by a driver. Notes: Identifier of TASK. Notes: Name of TASK.

terms.label: DM Duty Stretch MODEL::TYPE OF TASK
terms.definition: A TYPE OF TASK is a classification of TASKs. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF TASK. Notes: Name of TYPE OF TASK.

terms.definition: A FILL IN TIME is a non-productive period of driver time that is the result of the duty cutting procedure or is introduced to prolong a DRIVING SPELL to a minimum length. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for this FILL IN TIME. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for this FILL IN TIME. Notes: Duration of FILL IN TIME. Notes: Identifier of FILL IN TIME.

terms.label: DM Time Allowance MODEL::TIME ALLOWANCE
terms.definition: A TIME ALLOWANCE is a fixed paid time allowed to perform certain activities to prepare for or to complete the work assigned either to a BLOCK, a DUTY , a DUTY PART, a STRETCH or a SPELL. Notes: Duration of TIME ALLOWANCE. Notes: Identifier of TIME ALLOWANCE.

terms.label: DM Time Allowance MODEL::TYPE OF ALLOWANCE
terms.definition: A TYPE OF ALLOWANCE is a classification of additional paid times, including the information whether the allowance is given before or after the main activity. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF ALLOWANCE. Notes: Designator stating whether the ALLOWANCE is before or after the main activity.

terms.label: DM Driver Trip MODEL::DRIVER TRIP
terms.definition: A DRIVER TRIP is a planned non-driving movement of a driver within a DUTY PART between two TIMING POINTs that may include using one or several VEHICLE JOURNEYs on vehicles driven by other drivers. terms.label: DM Driver Trip MODEL::DRIVER TRIP TIME
terms.definition: A DRIVER TRIP TIME is the time allowed for a driver to cover a particular DRIVER TRIP during a specified TIME BAND. Notes: Allotted time to conduct DRIVER TRIP. Notes: Identifier of DRIVER TRIP TIME. Notes: The transport mode that the DRIVER TRIP TIME applies to.

terms.definition: A CONTINUOUS DUTY is a classification of a DUTY, in terms of working hours within the day comprising a single period of paid work. Notes: Identifier of CONTINUOUS DUTY.

terms.label: DM Duty Type MODEL::DUTY TYPE
terms.definition: A DUTY TYPE is a classification of a DUTY, in terms of working hours within the day. Notes: Description of DUTY TYPE. Notes: Identifier of DUTY TYPE. Notes: Name of DUTY TYPE.

terms.label: DM Duty Type MODEL::SPLIT DUTY
terms.definition: A SPLIT DUTY is a classification of a DUTY, in terms of working hours comprising several time bands separated in different DUTY PARTs by periods of unpaid time. Notes: Identifier of SPLIT DUTY.

terms.definition: A COLUMN/DAY is a column in a ROSTER MATRIX which is related to an OPERATING DAY. Notes: Identifier of COLUMN/DAY.

terms.label: DM Roster Matrix MODEL::REST
terms.definition: A REST is a representation of a day off for a driver. Notes: Identifier of REST.

terms.label: DM Roster Matrix MODEL::ROSTER ELEMENT
terms.definition: A ROSTER ELEMENT is a cell in a ROSTER MATRIX where the individual DUTY to be performed by a theoretically available driver on a certain OPERATING DAY is entered or it is marked that it is a day of rest. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER ELEMENT.

terms.label: DM Roster Matrix MODEL::ROSTER MATRIX
terms.definition: A ROSTER MATRIX is a table showing the duty plan for a period of days and for a number of theoretically available drivers. Notes: Description of ROSTER MATRIX. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER MATRIX.

terms.label: DM Roster Matrix MODEL::ROW/DRIVER
terms.definition: A ROW/DRIVER is a row in a ROSTER MATRIX which is related to a theoretically available driver. Notes: Identifier of ROW/DRIVER.

terms.label: DM Roster Cycle MODEL::ROSTER CYCLE
terms.definition: A ROSTER CYCLE is a sequence pattern of days of work and days of rest where the days of work may be further specified by a particular DUTY TYPE. Notes: Description of ROSTER CYCLE. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER CYCLE.

terms.label: DM Roster Cycle MODEL::ROSTER CYCLE ELEMENT
terms.definition: A ROSTER CYCLE ELEMENT is an element of a ROSTER CYCLE which represents a day of work or rest for a theoretically available driver in the ordered sequence of days for that cycle. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER CYCLE ELEMENT. Notes: Position of ROSTER CYCLE ELEMENT in the ROSTER CYCLE.

terms.label: DM Roster Cycle MODEL::WORK
terms.definition: A WORK is a representation of a day on duty for a driver. Notes: Identifier of WORK.

terms.label: DM Roster Design MODEL::DESIGN WEEK
terms.definition: A DESIGN WEEK is a week viewed as a part of a ROSTER DESIGN with a specified order in that design. Notes: Identifier of DESIGN WEEK. Notes: Position of DESIGN WEEK in ROSTER DESIGN.

terms.label: DM Roster Design MODEL::DESIGN WEEK ELEMENT
terms.definition: A DESIGN WEEK ELEMENT is an element of a DESIGN WEEK representing a particular DAY OF WEEK designating if it is a day of rest or work according to a specific DUTY TYPE for a theoretically available driver. Notes: Identifier of DESIGN WEEK ELEMENT

terms.label: DM Roster Design MODEL::ROSTER DESIGN
terms.definition: A ROSTER DESIGN is roster building unit made up of a particular number of DESIGN WEEKs to each of which a different sequence pattern of DUTY TYPEs and days of rest will be assigned. Notes: Description of ROSTER DESIGN. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER DESIGN.

terms.label: DM Roster Design MODEL::ROSTER DESIGN IN MATRIX
terms.definition: A ROSTER DESIGN IN MATRIX describes the order in which different ROSTER DESIGNs are applied to construct a certain ROSTER MATRIX. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER DESIGN IN MATRIX. Notes: Position of ROSTER DESIGN in ROSTER MATRIX.

terms.label: DM Roster Design MODEL::ROSTER DESIGN TYPE
terms.definition: A ROSTER DESIGN TYPE is a classification of a ROSTER DESIGN which may describe the number of weeks that are covered, the proportion of work to free days or other characteristics. Notes: Description of ROSTER DESIGN TYPE. Notes: Identifier of ROSTER DESIGN TYPE.

terms.label: DM Driver Assignment MODEL::ABSENCE
terms.definition: An ABSENCE represents an actual absence of an EMPLOYEE from work on a particular OPERATING DAY for a specified time. Notes: End time of ABSENCE. Notes: Identifier of ABSENCE. Notes: Order of ABSENCE during OPERATING DAY. Notes: Start time of ABSENCE.

terms.label: DM Driver Assignment MODEL::DRIVER ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: A DRIVER ASSIGNMENT is an assignment of an EMPLOYEE to a ROW/DRIVER in a ROSTER MATRIX for a specified OPERATING DAY. Notes: Identifier of DRIVER ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: DM Driver Assignment MODEL::TYPE OF ABSENCE
terms.definition: A TYPE OF ABSENCE is a classification that indicates the reason why an EMPLOYEE is absent from work and if it is a planned or un-planned absence. Notes: Broad type categorization for TYPE OF ABSENCE. Notes: Description of TYPE OF ABSENCE. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF ABSENCE.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::ACCOUNT ENTRY
terms.definition: An ACCOUNT ENTRY is a record of aggregated ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY data per WAGE TYPE, EMPLOYEE and COST CENTRE for one OPERATING DAY that is used to transfer information on duties actually worked by drivers to an external accounting system. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNT ENTRY. Notes: Sum of worked time recorded in the ACCOUNT ENTRY.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::ACCOUNTING PERIOD
terms.definition: An ACCOUNTING PERIOD is a continuous interval between two OPERATING DAYs which will be used for accounting purposes. Notes: Identifier of ACCOUNTING PERIOD. Notes: Name of ACCOUNTING PERIOD.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY
terms.definition: An ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY is a record, including data needed for accounting, of the actual time worked, planned as well as unplanned,in a STRETCH, or spent for a BREAK, by an EMPLOYEE on a specified OPERATING DAY. Notes: The proportion of the normal wage that is paid for the activity recorded in ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY. Notes: The full or reduced paid time applicable for the activity recorded in ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY. Notes: Actual end time of activity recorded in ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY. Notes: Actual start time of activity recorded in ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY. Notes: Identifier of ACTIVITY LOG ENTRY.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::COST CENTRE
terms.definition: A COST CENTRE is a business unit, or other type of classification used by the company’s accountancy department, to which costs can be collected or attributed according to cost type and origin. Notes: Description of COST CENTRE. Notes: Identifier of COST CENTRE.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::TYPE OF WAGE
terms.definition: A TYPE OF WAGE is a classification used for wage accounting, which associates sums of work time recorded in ACCOUNT ENTRies to TIME BANDs relevant for accounting. Notes: Description of TYPE OF WAGE. Notes: Identifier of TYPE OF WAGE.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::WAGE INCREASE
terms.definition: a WAGE INCREASE is an indication to the accountancy software that the performed work was affected by aggravating circumstances to such a degree that additional payment should be allotted. Notes: Description of WAGE INCREASE. Notes: Identifier of WAGE INCREASE.

terms.label: DM Driver Accounting MODEL::WAGE TYPE ASSIGNMENT
terms.definition: A WAGE TYPE ASSIGNMENT is an assignment of a TYPE OF WAGE to a DAY TYPE and a TIME BAND. Notes: Identifier of WAGE TYPE ASSIGNMENT.

terms.label: DC Driver Control Action MODEL::DRIVER CONTROL ACTION
terms.definition: A DRIVER CONTROL ACTION is a CONTROL ACTION affecting a LOGICAL DRIVER. Notes: Identifier of DRIVER CONTROL ACTION.

terms.label: DC Driver Control Action MODEL::CHANGE OF DRIVER
terms.definition: A CHANGE OF DRIVER is a CONTROL ACTION consisting in removing, at a certain point in time and space (in principle a RELIEF POINT), all work assigned to a LOGICAL DRIVER and of assigning it to another LOGICAL DRIVER. Notes: Identifier of CHANGE OF DRIVER. Notes: Time of CHANGE OF DRIVER.

terms.label: DC Driver Control Action MODEL::LOGICAL DRIVER CANCELLATION
terms.definition: A LOGICAL DRIVER CANCELLATION is a CONTROL ACTION consisting in removing a LOGICAL DRIVER from the production plan. Notes: Identifier of LOGICAL DRIVER CANCELLATION.

terms.label: DC Driver Control Action MODEL::LOGICAL DRIVER CREATION
terms.definition: A LOGICAL DRIVER CREATION is a CONTROL ACTION consisting in creating a completely new LOGICAL DRIVER and assigning dated spells to this LOGICAL DRIVER. Notes: Identifier of LOGICAL DRIVER CREATION.

terms.label: MI Recorded Objects MODEL::BOARDING AND ALIGHTING
terms.definition: The numbers of passengers boarding and alighting at a STOP POINT during a RECORDED STOP. Notes: Identifier of BOARDING AND ALIGHTING. Notes: Number of passengers alighting. Notes: Number of passengers boarding. Notes: Whether the VEHICLE is occupied.

terms.label: MI Recorded Objects MODEL::INTERCHANGE STATUS
terms.definition: The information about the actual status of a SERVICE JOURNEY INTERCHANGE on a specified OPERATING DAY. Recorded information on missed interchanges may be of particular interest. Notes: Cause of failing to make interchange, if any. Notes: Identifier of INTERCHANGE STATUS. Notes: Number of passengers making interchange.

terms.label: MI Recorded Objects MODEL::RECORDED LEG
terms.definition: The recording of the actual LEG followed by a passenger on an OPERATING DAY Notes: Identifier of RECORDED LEG.

terms.label: MI Recorded Objects MODEL::RECORDED STOP
terms.definition: The recorded stop at a STOP POINT during actual service operation to possibly let passengers board or alight the vehicle. Notes: Time at which VEHICLE doors were closed.. Notes: Time at which VEHICLE doors were opened. Notes: Identifier of RECORDED STOP.

terms.label: MI Recorded Objects MODEL::RECORDED TRIP
terms.definition: The actual TRIP undertaken by a passenger from an origin to a destination. Notes: Identifier of RECORDED TRIP
